summary.zh-Hans: 莱基保护中心位于拉各斯，由尼日利亚保护基金会管理，有林地、自然步道和栈道，可见猴类等野生动物。
summary.en: Lekki Conservation Centre in Lagos is managed by the Nigerian Conservation Foundation. It has forest, nature trails and a boardwalk, with wildlife including monkeys.

summary.zh-Hans: 妮凯艺术画廊位于拉各斯，展示尼日利亚及其他非洲国家的艺术作品。
summary.en: Nike Art Gallery in Lagos displays works from Nigeria and other African countries.

summary.zh-Hans: 拉各斯可见乔洛夫饭。一种做法将米与番茄、红椒、洋葱和香料一起烹调。
summary.en: Jollof rice is found in Lagos. One preparation cooks rice with tomato, red pepper, onion and spices.

summary.zh-Hans: Puff-puff是油炸面团球，可做成甜味。做法可使用面粉、酵母、糖和水，让面团发起后炸制。
summary.en: Puff-puff are deep-fried dough balls that can be sweet. One preparation uses flour, yeast, sugar and water, letting the dough rise before frying.
